subject: Re: [AMBER] Potential Bug in QM/MM Virial Calculation and Suggestions for Ewald Error Estimation in AMBER

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Jul 06, 2025, Zihao Bai wrote:
>
>I am doing TI between MM and QM/MM (as in this paper,
>DOI: 10.1021/acs.jctc.6b01217). I noticed that TI appears to be
>incompatible with the Monte Carlo barostat in Sander.
>
>Given that the Berendsen barostat may lead to problematic
>virial and density values (it seems also reported by others:
>
http://archive.ambermd.org/201212/0011.html
), I was wondering if you have
>any suggestions or recommended alternatives to address this?
One, perhaps possible, idea: equilibrate the density using MM only, then run
QM/MM in NVT.  You would need to decide if you really need volume
fluctuations during the QM part of the simulation.
....dac
